entities.name: Hans Eriksson
entities.description: A human scout from the Ice Age and brother of Saffi Eriksdotter, who survived the lhurgoyf's attacks.

entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: Hans's sister, killed by a lhurgoyf while on guard duty.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: A creature that killed Saffi and later attacked the town mead hall.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Region in the grip of the great Ice Age.

events.summary: A lhurgoyf attacks Hans and Saffi on guard duty, killing Saffi while Hans runs to warn the town.
events.quote: His sister was killed in the attack, whereas Hans ran to the town to warn others.

events.summary: The lhurgoyf attacks the mead hall, but Hans again stays unharmed.
events.quote: The lhurgoyf later attacked the town mead hall where the warriors gathered

relations.quote: He was the brother of Saffi Eriksdotter .

relations.note: Killed her in an attack on guard duty
relations.quote: His sister was killed in the attack
